created_prompt:
Help me develop a concrete three year plan to accomplish my dual goals of growing online and publishing a cookbook.

Growing online: I currently have 1.2M followers who watch my videos. I focus on quick, healthy recipes. I want to grow my online presence over the next three years.

Cookbook: I would like to publish a cookbook, either self-published or via traditional publishing methods. I'm not sure which, so you should bear this in mind when creating the plan as I may choose one or the other.

I work four days a week, so I have a limited time and budget. Create a three-year plan to help me accomplish these goals. Break this down by year, month, and week, so that I can see measurable progress toward goals each week.
